# The Effect of Leader-Follower Hypercompetitiveness Dissimilarity on Relationship and Performance Outcomes

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Chandra S. Pathki, R. Gabrielle Swab, Donald H. Kluemper, Paul D. Johnson  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Leadership Quarterly  
**DOI:** [10.1177/10596011251381477](https://doi.org/10.1177/10596011251381477)  
**Publisher:** [https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/10596011251381477](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/10596011251381477)

**Keywords:** hypercompetitiveness, leader-follower relationship, dissimilarity, performance, LMX, personality

## Abstract

Examines how dissimilarity in hypercompetitiveness between leaders and followers affects their relationship quality and performance outcomes, contributing to understanding of personality dissimilarity in leadership dynamics.
